newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent crude rangebound with May expiry.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent crude rangebound with May expiry.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude trades on late Tuesday afternoon remained rangebound with brokers saying sentiment was largely unchanged.
"We are just trading into the May expiry, sentiment is unchanged from this morning," said a broker.
"Technically, levels should improve and NYMEX could move higher to breach the $20.00 per barrel mark but so far trades were rangebound," said another broker.
June was last traded at $18.35 a barrel, up eight cents from its morning trade of $18.27 but just three cents higher from its previous London close of $18.32.
Brokers said June was seeing good buying support at the $18.25/$18.26 level.

They said the market had already discounted further impact of a report that U.S. and Saudi intelligence authorities have linked a senior Iranian government official to a group suspected of bombing a U.S. military compound in Saudi Arabia last year.
NYMEX crude on ACCESS was quoted unchanged from its morning trade of $19.91 per barrel.
